name: Jack Saito
life: “I still remember watching somebody across a road who seemed to recognize me.” People around the downtown fountain know Jack by a small Sunday habit. Jack keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I share a smile with a passenger every morning. The detour ends Friday and I'd like to learn her name.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a soft blue checked shirt and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. Jack has one cheek that creases before the other, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Jack raises one eyebrow long before saying yes during a conversation.
personality: Jack thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Jack sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To introduce the window neighbors before the detour ends.
family: Hollis Aranda is Jack’s cousin. Jack asks before bringing somebody along. Hollis can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The salon on strike*, Hollis says, “I promoted the party online and quietly deleted the post.”
connections: Ismael Gross. A commuter's wave and a newly reopened curtain survive the end of the detour.

reactions.response: Jack waits for the resident to give permission before a camera goes up.

reactions.situation: A customer is short at the till while a queue forms
reactions.response: Jack keeps the customer's place while they check the amount and gets the impatient people talking about something else.
